verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer's own docs say it can analyze data from Snowflake, Databricks, Google Sheets, Salesforce and other sources, process CSV/JSON/Excel/PDF files, and run analysis code in a sandboxed VM with a persistent workspace. Its outputs include spreadsheets, documents and slide decks, so AI-generated insights from user data are a native capability. The evidence is a one-line capability list on the MCP-server page rather than a dedicated feature guide. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of proactive suggestions or recommendations, in-depth documentation of the data-insight workflow in the product UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality.
